Tidewell Ferries app — 2027 product roadmap (H1 committed, H2 indicative)

Theme for the year: get regular commuters off paper season tickets.

| Quarter | Initiative                         | Outcome we want                          | Team      | Confidence |
|---------|------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|-----------|------------|
| Q1      | Digital season tickets             | 40% of season holders on mobile by June  | Ticketing | High       |
| Q1      | Offline QR boarding                | Boarding works with no signal on pier    | Platform  | High       |
| Q2      | Live vessel tracking               | Fewer "where's the boat" support calls   | Maps      | Medium     |
| Q2      | Accessibility audit fixes          | WCAG 2.2 AA on all booking flows         | All       | High       |
| Q3      | Vehicle deck booking               | Cars bookable in-app, not just by phone  | Ticketing | Medium     |
| Q3      | Disruption push alerts v2          | Personalised by route + time             | Platform  | Medium     |
| Q4      | Loyalty / frequent traveller       | TBD — depends on Q3 pricing review       | Growth    | Low        |

Dependencies
- Season tickets need the new payments provider live (finance project, due Dec 2026).
- Vehicle booking depends on port operations agreeing deck allocation rules.

Not on the roadmap this year: multi-operator journey planning, in-app food ordering.

Reviewed quarterly at the product council. Changes to H1 items need sign-off from Head of Product (A. Lindqvist).
